Our topic today is the reality of value. There are different sorts of value — but we will focus on the reality of moral value.
Talk about moral value includes talk about the rightness or wrongness of actions, the goodness or badness of persons, and the goodness or badness of outcomes or situations.

To ask about the reality of moral value is to ask: are there really facts about what actions and right and what wrong? Are there facts about which people are good and which bad? Are there facts about which outcomes are better than which others?
